pages.title: Feed the Weightless
pages.text: Connect feeding a creature with a new way to alter block gravity.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Follow its native food tooltip first. The ectoplasm affects block gravity; arbitrary food and targets are not guaranteed to work.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Accepted feeding yields ectoplasm; its throw has a separate gravity use.
